title: GateMailMessagePage
description: Response of GET /mail/proton/folders/:folder/messages?fromUid=&limit= (#195): raw RFC 5322 messages as base64, UID ascending, at most limit of them and at most 32 MiB of raw bytes in all. The gate does not parse them. skipped lists the UIDs in range that were left out because a message is over 25 MiB on its own.

items.title: GateMailRawMessage
items.description: One message: its UID and its raw bytes as standard base64.
